question_stem: A nucleus of plutonium-238 ($^{238}_{94}\text{Pu}$) decays by emitting an $\alpha$-particle to produce a new nucleus $X$ and $5.6\ \text{MeV}$ of energy. The decay is represented by $$^{238}_{94}\text{Pu} \rightarrow X + \alpha + 5.6\ \text{MeV}.$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Determine the number of protons and the number of neutrons in nucleus $X$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate the number of plutonium-238 nuclei that must decay in a time of $1.0\ \text{s}$ to produce a power of $0.15\ \text{W}$.
